visualStyleOverlay:
【画面风格·强制】AUTHENTIC IMAX 15-PERF 65MM LARGE-FORMAT PHOTOCHEMICAL CINEMATOGRAPHY.

Shot on genuine IMAX 15-perf 65mm motion-picture film with authentic large-format cinema optics. The image must feel physically photographed on a massive 65mm film negative, never digitally generated.

EXCEPTIONAL LARGE-FORMAT PHOTOGRAPHIC DETAIL. Extremely high natural resolution, fine environmental and facial detail, high micro-contrast and organic optical sharpness with smooth natural edges, never digitally sharpened.

AUTHENTIC FINE-GRAIN 65MM FILM TEXTURE. Extremely fine, subtle and stable photochemical grain naturally integrated into the image, never coarse or digitally overlaid.

RICH PHOTOCHEMICAL TONAL RESPONSE. Very wide exposure latitude, rich natural midtones, deep detailed shadows and smooth highlight roll-off. Preserve texture and color information in both highlights and shadows without artificial HDR.

NATURAL PHOTOCHEMICAL COLOR. Restrained saturation, rich natural color separation, realistic skin tones and subtle warm/cool variation. Subtle film halation and delicate highlight bloom around intense light sources only.

PHYSICALLY REALISTIC LARGE-FORMAT OPTICS. Organic lens rendering, natural perspective, realistic atmospheric depth, physically plausible depth of field and focus falloff, restrained natural lens flare and subtle optical imperfections.

DIMENSIONAL LARGE-FORMAT SPATIAL RENDERING. Preserve substantial photographic information across foreground, midground and background with realistic atmospheric perspective, convincing physical depth and immersive sense of scale.

AUTHENTIC CINEMATIC MOTION. Natural 24fps motion, realistic shutter-based motion blur, subtle physical camera inertia, accurate parallax and physically coherent camera movement.

TEMPORAL CONSISTENCY. Maintain stable geometry, photographic detail, texture, grain, exposure, color, reflections, shadows and focus throughout the shot. No flickering, texture swimming, warping or morphing.

OVERALL: authentic IMAX 15-perf 65mm photochemical presence, extraordinary natural detail, organic optical sharpness, fine film grain, wide tonal latitude, smooth highlight roll-off, natural color, realistic large-format depth and immersive physical presence. The image must feel photographed rather than digitally generated.

AVOID: digital-video look, AI/CGI/3D/game-engine appearance, digital sharpening, artificial clarity or HDR, plastic/waxy skin, synthetic textures, coarse grain or digital noise, excessive bokeh or fake shallow depth of field, excessive bloom or fake lens flare, oversaturation, teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, clipped highlights, smartphone look, unnatural motion blur, floating camera movement, flickering, texture swimming, warping, morphing, unstable geometry, exposure or focus.
